prs.title: Fix issue where client tool call hangs forever if server crashes or connection dies when using streamable-http
prs.author: gyang-xai
prs.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Client tool calls hang indefinitely when the server crashes or the SSE connection dies — the waiting request never receives an error signal. (2 PRs)
prs.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: Client tool calls hang indefinitely when the server crashes or the SSE connection dies — the waiting request never receives an error signal. (2 PRs)
prs.cluster_pick_reason: PR #1578 fixes the root cause directly: it adds `_send_error_response` and wraps `_handle_post_request` in a try/except so an explicit JSONRPCError is sent back to the waiting caller, unblocking it immediately. PR #2122 addresses the same symptom but only indirectly — it raises MAX_RECONNECTION_ATTEMPTS from 2 to 5 (delaying rather than resolving the hang) and adds a warning log in the default message handler. #1578's approach is more complete and correct; #2122's reconnection-count change can be applied on top of #1578 if desired.

clusters.pick_reason: PR #1578 fixes the root cause directly: it adds `_send_error_response` and wraps `_handle_post_request` in a try/except so an explicit JSONRPCError is sent back to the waiting caller, unblocking it immediately. PR #2122 addresses the same symptom but only indirectly — it raises MAX_RECONNECTION_ATTEMPTS from 2 to 5 (delaying rather than resolving the hang) and adds a warning log in the default message handler. #1578's approach is more complete and correct; #2122's reconnection-count change can be applied on top of #1578 if desired.
